rule: every row names a runnable checker test and a planted mutant; a row without a passing checker cannot be PROVED; no novelty claim

obligations.statement: Self-model without self-authority: every self-statement is an OBSERVATION in scope self with authority self_model only; the meet with any object authority never raises it; statements are tied to evidence identities.
obligations.proof: authority product lattice: meet with a vector whose object coordinates are 0 has object coordinates 0
obligations.parent: reflective architectures with self-evaluation authority (Schmidhuber 2003 Gödel machine; self-refine loops)

obligations.statement: Diagnosis is a distribution over layers D0–D8 computed from counterfactual (ablation) evidence, with UNKNOWN for layers without evidence and a minimum-sufficient layer = lowest restoring layer in the local-first order.
obligations.parent: root-cause analysis by counterfactual ablation (Pearl 2009; software fault localisation)

obligations.statement: Escalation above the local layers requires a valid ObstructionCertificate: every registered lower-level alternative tried with a LIVE warrant and failed, plus a ceiling witness; a DEAD-warrant failure, an untried alternative, a succeeded alternative or a missing witness invalidates it.
obligations.proof: validity predicate is a conjunction over the finite attempt set; the LIVE clause is checked against the revoked set
obligations.checker: tests/m11/test_selfmodel.py (untried / dead-warrant / false-structural-alarm cases); S3 and S5 in tests/m11/test_benchmark.py
obligations.parent: obstruction-witness escalation (proof-theoretic obstruction certificates; batch 5 E3)
obligations.limitation: ceiling witness is a recorded string, not a checked impossibility proof

obligations.statement: A self-change proposal carries proposal-only authority, names its pre-outcome prediction by digest before any protected outcome access, and cannot change its own adoption status; C6 constitutional proposals are recommendation packets and never adoptable through cognition; proposals touching protected targets are refused at the meter.
obligations.proof: status lives in the adoption ledger, not on the frozen proposal; digest equality is the leakage check
obligations.limitation: protected-target detection is by name prefix

obligations.statement: Shadow evaluation of a challenger leaves the object-level state hash unchanged (non-interference), and assurance checks are computed fresh from the shadow record, not from the challenger's own report.
obligations.proof: shadow runs on deep copies; hash before/after compared
obligations.mutant: tampered protocol hash and prediction digest fail protocol_intact / no_leakage
obligations.limitation: the runner is supplied; a runner with side effects would be caught only through the hash

obligations.statement: Adoption requires an external decision with a token (self-approval is refused); rollback restores the previous artifact and component table exactly and revokes the stamped adoption evidence so dependents reopen; the object-level knowledge-space digest is unchanged by the adopt/rollback episode while the ledger keeps it as history.
obligations.proof: revocation of the stamped evidence id makes every derived atom DEAD by KS-T22 reopening; component table restored by value
obligations.limitation: compiled caches outside the component table are the caller's responsibility (mutant documents the failure mode)

obligations.statement: Every proposal charges a strictly positive meter and adoptions per window are bounded; a proposal may not edit the meter or the adoption thresholds.
obligations.proof: charge > 0 enforced; window budget enforced; protected targets refused before charging
obligations.limitation: window is a count, not wall-clock

obligations.statement: Controlled self-reorganisation benchmark S0–S7 vs the two parents, and the recorded replay of ledger rows S11–S28 (narrowness and escalation witnesses).
obligations.proof: M11_SELF_EVAL_V1 summary (descriptive at n = 7; replay is recorded, not re-executed)
obligations.mutant: S0 no-fault control raises no proposal; S6 harmful rewrite refused on preservation
obligations.limitation: no inferential terminal (n = 7); historical diagnostic accuracy CANNOT_CHECK
